context: A teacher discusses a regional study with a student
purpose: Teach: 宮城/大島/荒川/金子/今井/市川/片山/熊谷

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、宮城の海岸線と大島の人口動態、対比が興味深いですね。
lines.en: Your paper—the contrast between the Miyagi coastline and Oshima's demographic shifts is really compelling.
lines.style: Warm, measured approval. Eyes engaged on the work itself, not the student. Open posture leaning slightly forward. Clear articulation, unhurried pace. The tone of someone noticing something worth noticing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。荒川流域の都市と、金子先生の地方論、参考にしました。
lines.en: Yes. I drew heavily on Arakawa basin urbanization and Professor Kaneko's regional framework.
lines.style: Steady, precise. Small respectful nod on the professor references. Even pacing, careful not to overstate. The careful speech of someone who has thought through their sources. Slight brightening at evidence of solid foundational reading.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今井氏のフィールドワーク、市川での住民調査、丁寧ですね。
lines.en: Imai's fieldwork—the resident surveys in Ichikawa are particularly meticulous.
lines.style: Recognition landing with quiet emphasis on 「meticulous」. Leaning in slightly, as if examining something under glass. Deliberate, engaged pace. The voice of someone genuinely impressed by methodological care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 片山先生の比較研究、熊谷の事例まで及んでいます。
lines.en: Katayama's comparative analysis actually extends all the way to the Kumagaya case studies.
lines.style: Slight tilt of the head, testing Ren's depth. Not challenging—curious. Pause before 「all the way」, letting him hear that she's noticed the scope. Warm but precise. Checking if he understands what he's citing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: Just make sure your region-by-region interpretation stays grounded and precise throughout.
lines.style: Gentle advisory that lands as genuine care, not critique. Softer attack on the first clause. Slight lean back—settling into mentor mode. Deliberate pacing. A teacher making space for the student to do better work.
